title: Serious Concerns Raised Over Patient Safety at Scottish Hospital
subtitle: A senior surgeon calls for a police investigation after reports of avoidable deaths in surgery.

summary.en: A senior surgeon at Aberdeen Royal Infirmary has called for a police investigation into patient deaths. An internal report confirmed that 19 patients died due to surgical complications between 2015 and 2021. The hospital board is facing intense pressure to explain these failures. While the Scottish government has ordered leadership changes, some leaders are demanding further accountability. Patient safety remains the primary focus as investigations continue.
summary.zh: 亞伯丁皇家醫院的一位資深外科醫師呼籲針對病患死亡事件進行警方調查。一份內部報告證實，二零一五年至二零二一年間，有十九名病患因手術併發症死亡。醫院管理局正面臨解釋這些疏失的巨大壓力。儘管蘇格蘭政府已下令更換領導層，但部分領袖仍要求進一步追究責任。隨著調查持續進行，病患安全仍是首要關注焦點。

paragraphs.en: A major health crisis has emerged in Scotland following serious allegations regarding surgical care at Aberdeen Royal Infirmary. Dr. Mohammed Habib, a consultant surgeon at the hospital, has officially called for a criminal investigation into the facility. This request follows the discovery that at least 19 patients died due to avoidable complications during liver and pancreatic surgeries between 2015 and 2021.
paragraphs.zh: 蘇格蘭發生了一場重大的醫療危機，起因是針對亞伯丁皇家醫院（Aberdeen Royal Infirmary）外科護理的嚴重指控。該院的外科顧問醫師穆罕默德·哈比（Mohammed Habib）已正式要求對該院進行刑事調查。在此之前，調查發現二零一五年至二零二一年間，至少有十九名病患因肝臟與胰臟手術中可避免的併發症而死亡。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian Health, Dr. Habib began raising concerns about the safety of these surgical procedures as early as 2021. He alleges that senior officials at NHS Grampian, the health board responsible for the hospital, did not act quickly enough to address these life-threatening issues. Following his reports, the board commissioned an expert review. This internal report, which was recently made public by Dr. Habib’s lawyer, confirmed that 19 patients suffered from serious, avoidable events during their treatment.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報健康》（The Guardian Health）報導，哈比醫師早在二零二一年就開始對這些外科手術的安全性提出疑慮。他指控負責該醫院的格蘭扁國家醫療服務局（NHS Grampian）高層官員，未能及時採取行動以解決這些危及生命的議題。在他提出報告後，該局委託了專家進行審查。這份近期由哈比醫師的律師公開的內部報告證實，有十九名病患在治療過程中遭遇了嚴重且可避免的醫療事故。

paragraphs.en: The findings of the report are deeply worrying. Two external experts from universities in Edinburgh and Leeds reviewed the hospital’s data and found that the death rate for liver and pancreatic surgery was as high as 18% between 2017 and 2020. This is significantly higher than the national average, which typically ranges between 2% and 3% for these types of operations. Despite these findings, Dr. Habib claims that the unit continued to perform these complex surgeries. He has since identified four additional patients who died during or after surgery since the expert report was completed.
paragraphs.zh: 該報告的調查結果令人深感擔憂。兩位來自愛丁堡與里茲大學的外部專家審查了該醫院的數據，發現二零一七年至二零二零年間，肝臟與胰臟手術的死亡率高達百分之十八。這遠高於此類手術通常百分之二至百分之三的全國平均水準。儘管有這些發現，哈比醫師聲稱該單位仍持續進行這些複雜的手術。自專家報告完成以來，他已另外確認有四名病患在手術期間或術後死亡。

paragraphs.en: The situation has sparked a heated debate in the Scottish Parliament. John Swinney, Scotland’s first minister, described the disclosures as being of the “gravest concern.” He emphasized that the National Health Service (NHS) has a legal duty to provide the best possible care to patients and to investigate safety failures immediately. However, Mr. Swinney stopped short of ordering a criminal investigation into the hospital board. Instead, he argued that the government’s recent demands for new leadership and urgent reforms at NHS Grampian would be enough to create the necessary improvements.
paragraphs.zh: 此情況在蘇格蘭議會引發了激烈的辯論。蘇格蘭首席大臣約翰·史溫尼（John Swinney）形容這些披露的資訊「極度令人憂心」。他強調，國家醫療服務（NHS）有法律義務為病患提供最佳的照護，並立即調查安全疏失。然而，史溫尼並未下令對醫院管理局進行刑事調查。相反地，他主張政府近期對格蘭扁國家醫療服務局提出的領導層更迭與緊急改革要求，足以帶來必要的改善。

paragraphs.en: This position has faced criticism from opposition leaders. Michael Marra, the Scottish Labour leader, argued that the families of the 19 people who died deserve both answers and justice. He called for a formal police investigation into what he described as “systemic failures”—meaning problems that are built into the way the organization is run—at the health board. The call for a criminal investigation into corporate homicide, which is the legal term for when an organization is responsible for a death due to serious management failures, highlights the severity of the situation.
paragraphs.zh: 此立場遭到反對黨領袖的批評。蘇格蘭工黨領袖麥可·馬拉（Michael Marra）主張，十九名死者的家屬理應獲得答案與正義。他呼籲針對他所稱的該醫療局「系統性失敗」——意指組織運作方式中根深蒂固的問題——進行正式的警方調查。針對企業過失殺人（即組織因嚴重的管理疏失導致死亡時的法律術語）進行刑事調查的呼聲，凸顯了事態的嚴重性。

paragraphs.en: In response to these allegations, Laura Skaife-Knight, the chief executive of NHS Grampian, stated that the board is aware of the serious claims. She noted that a thorough investigation has already taken place and that some parts of that work are still ongoing. She explained that the board must respect the privacy of patients and staff, but they are committed to the “duty of candour.” This is a legal requirement for health organizations to be open and honest with patients and their families when something goes wrong with their care. Ms. Skaife-Knight added that if new evidence is found, the board will contact any additional individuals who may have been affected.
paragraphs.zh: 針對這些指控，格蘭扁國家醫療服務局執行長蘿拉·斯凱夫-奈特（Laura Skaife-Knight）表示，管理局已知悉這些嚴重的指控。她指出，相關單位已進行徹底調查，且部分工作仍在進行中。她解釋，管理局必須尊重病患與員工的隱私，但他們致力於履行「坦誠義務」。這是一項法律要求，規定醫療組織在照護過程中出現問題時，必須對病患及其家屬保持公開與誠實。斯凱夫-奈特補充說，若發現新證據，管理局將聯繫任何可能受影響的額外人士。

paragraphs.en: This latest development adds to the growing pressure on healthcare systems across the United Kingdom. As reported in previous coverage, the government is already facing significant challenges regarding NHS services. In England, nearly half of all maternity units have been found to fall short of basic safety standards, and similar efforts are underway in Wales to improve emergency room delays. These combined issues have created a difficult environment for health officials who are struggling to maintain public trust.
paragraphs.zh: 這項最新進展加劇了英國各地醫療體系所面臨的壓力。正如先前的報導所述，政府在國家醫療服務的服務項目上已面臨重大挑戰。在英格蘭，近半數的婦產科單位被發現未達基本安全標準，威爾斯也正採取類似措施以改善急診室延誤的問題。這些綜合議題為正努力維持公眾信任的衛生官員創造了艱困的環境。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the situation at Aberdeen Royal Infirmary remains critical. In March 2026, another external expert warned hospital executives that the persistent high death rate in complex surgery was a “red flag”—a clear sign of danger that cannot be ignored. As the hospital works to implement leadership changes and address the findings of the expert reviews, the families affected and the public are waiting to see if these measures will be enough to ensure that future surgeries are safe. For now, the debate over whether internal reforms are sufficient or if a full police investigation is required continues to dominate the conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，亞伯丁皇家醫院的情況依然危急。二零二六年三月，另一位外部專家曾警告醫院高層，複雜手術中持續偏高的死亡率是一個「危險訊號」，即不容忽視的明確警示。隨著醫院致力於落實領導層變動並處理專家審查的結果，受影響的家屬與大眾正等待觀察這些措施是否足以確保未來的醫療手術安全。目前，關於內部改革是否足夠，或是需要進行全面警方調查的辯論，仍是討論的焦點。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To decide not to do something extreme or final, even though you did other related things.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 決定不做某件極端或最終的事（儘管做了其他相關的事）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是一個常見的片語，容易誤以為是「停在...前面」。文中：However, Mr. Swinney stopped short of ordering a criminal investigation into the hospital board.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To fail to reach a required standard or expectation.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡的 fall 並非「跌倒」，而是指未達標。文中：In England, nearly half of all maternity units have been found to fall short of basic safety standards, and similar efforts are underway in Wales to improve emergency room delays.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A warning sign that something is wrong and needs attention.
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面上是「紅旗」，但在這裡指代危險的徵兆。文中：In March 2026, another external expert warned hospital executives that the persistent high death rate in complex surgery was a “red flag”—a clear sign of danger that cannot be ignored.

quiz.question: What specifically did the external expert review reveal about the surgical outcomes at Aberdeen Royal Infirmary between 2017 and 2020?

options.A: The death rate was slightly higher than the national average of 10%.
options.B: The death rate reached 18%, which significantly exceeded the national average.
options.C: The hospital successfully reduced the death rate to 2% through internal reforms.
options.D: The death rate was consistent with other hospitals across the United Kingdom.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，外部專家審查發現 2017 年至 2020 年間，該院肝臟與胰臟手術的死亡率高達 18%，遠高於全國平均的 2% 至 3%。選項 A 錯誤，因為全國平均並非 10%；選項 C 錯誤，因為文章指出死亡率高，且並未提到改革成功降低了死亡率；選項 D 錯誤，因為數據顯示該院明顯高於全國平均，而非一致。

quiz.question: Based on the text, what is the underlying reason for the disagreement between the Scottish government and opposition leaders regarding the hospital?

options.A: They disagree on whether the hospital's leadership should be replaced immediately.
options.B: They disagree on whether the 19 patient deaths were actually avoidable.
options.C: They differ on whether internal reforms are sufficient or if criminal accountability is necessary.
options.D: They disagree on whether the NHS has a legal duty to provide safe care to patients.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第四段提到第一部長 John Swinney 認為內部改革與撤換領導層已足夠，但第五段提到反對黨領袖 Michael Marra 認為這類「系統性失敗」需要正式的警察調查以實現正義。選項 A 不正確，因為雙方都支持改革；選項 B 錯誤，因為報告已證實死亡是可以避免的；選項 D 錯誤，因為雙方都認同 NHS 的法律責任。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, the expert describes the high death rate as a 'red flag.' What does this phrase mean in this context?

options.A: A decorative symbol used in medical reports.
options.B: A warning sign indicating a serious problem that requires immediate attention.
options.C: A formal requirement to pause all surgical operations indefinitely.
options.D: A standard procedure for reporting routine administrative errors.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在文中，「red flag」被用來形容持續的高死亡率，這是一種比喻，指「危險訊號」或「警示」，意即必須立即處理的嚴重問題。選項 A 將其誤解為實體符號；選項 C 過度解讀，文中並未說這代表必須停止所有手術；選項 D 錯誤，因為這並非例行公事，而是關於生命安全的嚴重警訊。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of this article?

options.A: A historical overview of surgical advancements in Scottish hospitals.
options.B: The personal career struggles of Dr. Mohammed Habib at Aberdeen Royal Infirmary.
options.C: A comparison between the healthcare systems of England, Wales, and Scotland.
options.D: The controversy surrounding avoidable patient deaths and the call for accountability at a Scottish hospital.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。全文的核心在於報導 Aberdeen Royal Infirmary 發生的一連串手術死亡事件，以及隨之而來的政治爭議、責任歸屬問題（是否需刑事調查）與公眾信任危機。選項 A 偏離主題；選項 B 僅是事件的一小部分，非全文核心；選項 C 雖然在第七段提及其他地區，但僅是作為背景補充，而非文章主旨。
